ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white/light-gray pixels occupy approximately 85% of the visible surface area, contrasting sharply with a low-intensity black/dark-gray perimeter and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The majority of the surface exhibits a uniform high-intensity distribution. Four distinct, low-intensity elliptical blobs are located in the lower central region near the peduncle junction. A continuous low-intensity boundary is mapped along the entire trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression at the vertical midline with an approximate acute angle of 70 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude pixel variations (serrations) are visible along the linear boundary from the notch to the distal tips, with higher amplitude irregularities at the far lateral terminals.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a sigmoidal curve; concave near the median notch transitioning to a broad convexity towards the lateral edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast dark pixels with irregular textures are visible at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, fragmented pixel clusters at the distal tips of the fluke lobes indicate potential prior colonization or minor physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinctive quartet of dark pigmentation spots arranged in a diamond-like pattern on the lower central fluke surface.
